title: J'Moris presents a new single "Being Humble"
htmlContent:
J'Moris returned with a new single called "Being Humble," which features a fresh and untouchable state of mind, ready to enjoy the journey of life to the fullest. The single "Being Humble" is accompanied by an official music video directed by Artist Named Chi, who also collaborated with J'Moris on "Activated".

Watch:

J'Moris's "Being Humble" is an impressive release for an artist who pours so much life into his music. The care in the music shines through with the production that grabs your attention, the conviction as well as presence to the flow, and the lyricism that makes it more real for us all to enjoy without limits.

Stream "Beng Humble" on Spotify.
